services.desc: Whether it’s a neighborhood park, a school, or even a sculpture garden, short disc golf courses are bringing fun, affordable recreation to communities all over the world. Short courses help new disc golfers fall in love with the game: You’re 10% more likely to play a second round when your first is on an easier course. With more than 17,000 courses worldwide - 89% of which are free - disc golf gets community members outside and moving for little to no cost. services.desc: Ready to bring disc golf to your area, but not sure how to get started? No matter your role, disc golf can deliver affordable, accessible recreation to your community. Use UDisc's Disc Golf Health Index to analyze the availability, variety, and opportunity for disc golf course infrastructure down to the county/regional level. It's a way for you to examine how well your community is performing when it comes to providing disc golf as a recreational outlet and, more importantly, where it will be most impactful for you to build your first - or next - course.
